title: When a Toy Becomes a Projectile | Parenting Rewind
description:
The toy flies across the room after one frustrated moment. A practical pause-and-rewind response for parents.

General parenting education; every child and family is different.
audience_intent: Adults and parents; not directed to children
education_scope: General parenting education only; not personalised therapy, diagnosis, or medical advice.

narration.transcript: The toy flies across the room after one frustrated moment. Threatening to remove every toy for a month is hard to follow and unrelated to what happened. Before reacting, pause for one breath so the next words can be short, clear, and useful. Use an immediate logical response: Trucks are for rolling; if you throw it again, this truck rests until tomorrow. Warnings work when they are specific, reasonable, and followed by exactly the consequence you named.

source.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
source.title: Tips for Using Consequences

claim_limits: The suggested wording is an example, not a guarantee.
Families should adapt expectations to age, development, safety and individual needs.
